# Digi_TransX

> Digi_TransX is a D-HAG digital transport marketplace project under development and private testing.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://digi-transx.d-hag.com/): Project scope, workflow concept, development status, and contact information.
- [D-HAG](https://d-hag.com/): Parent organization and project portfolio.

## Important status

- Digi_TransX is not publicly launched.
- Public booking, live payments, GPS tracking, authentication, and production transport services are not offered by this website.
- Contact: support@d-hag.com
